question: Town J is to the south of Town K. Town L is to the east of Town K. Town M is to the north of Town L. Town N is to the east of Town M. Town O is to the northeast of Town N. What is the position of Town O with respect to Town J?
solution:
Given: 

Town J is to the south of Town K.

Town L is to the east of Town K.

Town M is to the north of Town L.

Town N is to the east of Town M.

Town O is to the northeast of Town N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/619fe25defa0775fabe9a1ca5c2ae9e56950f715e7a8b0e8ed72bd56ab4b5292.png] 

So, **Northeast** is the position of Town O with respect to Town J.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
